groups.sentence: The institution provides AI training and professional development for faculty and staff.
The institution builds AI literacy into curricula, courses and learning outcomes across disciplines.
The institution requires students to take AI literacy courses, workshops or orientation.
Instructors share or recommend AI literacy modules, resources and trainings with their students.
Instructors teach students how AI works, its limits, and its ethical and responsible use.
Instructors and staff may help students learn about AI through hands-on activities and demonstrations.
The institution offers AI courses, workshops, modules and resources to its community.
AI literacy is an essential skill that students, faculty and staff need to develop.
The institution provides training, workshops and support so students, faculty and staff understand and use AI responsibly.
Students are pointed to guides, tutorials and courses for learning about generative AI and using it responsibly.
Community members attend AI training, workshops and use available AI resources.
Students seek out training and learning opportunities to build their AI literacy.
All students, faculty and staff complete required AI training, often every year or at onboarding.
Completion of AI training may be required before people are given access to certain AI tools.
